subject: MarketFit bake-off credits for benchmark sprint
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@swanhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@swanhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask: credits for an upcoming benchmark sprint

Hi Vanessa,

We have a bake-off next month called the MarketFit benchmark — Swan Health is running an apples-to-apples eval between Redwood and BlueTorch AI to validate latency, hallucination rate, and cost per inference for our clinical summarization pipeline. The procurement team asked me to reach out to see if Redwood can provide promotional credits (token allowance) and a small extension window so we can complete the test run across a broader sample set.

Rough ask: 50k token-equivalent credits and a 30-day trial window with a single 30-day extension if needed. We will share the scorecards and a short post-mortem; if Redwood wins the bake-off there’s a clear path to a POC and then enterprise purchase.

Attached: swan_bakeoff_scope.docx (scope & timeline).

Can you confirm whether this is feasible and any standard terms we should expect?

Thanks,
Emma Clarke
Senior Product Manager, Data Platform
Swan Health

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@swanhealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: credits for an upcoming benchmark sprint

Hi Emma — great to meet you, and thanks for the brief.

We'd love to support Swan Health's benchmark. A few quick notes and a proposed offer so you can move forward with procurement:

- Offer: 30k token-equivalent credits (pre-provisioned) + a 30-day trial.
- Extension: one 30-day extension available upon request if you share interim results and a short status note.
- If Redwood is selected in the bake-off and you convert to a POC within 60 days, we can apply a 15% onboarding credit toward the first month of committed usage.

I’m looping in Stephanie (Revenue Ops) to confirm whether we can stretch to 50k and to handle the procurement steps. I can also add a solutions engineer for a short kickoff + test-case calibration session.

Attached: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (high-level flow).

Would you be available for a 30-minute sync on Monday to align on test inputs and verification metrics?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T12:14:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: MarketFit bake-off — credit ask (Swan Health)

Folks — quick internal ask. Swan Health (Emma Clarke) has an RFP-style bake-off vs BlueTorch AI. They requested 50k token credits + 30d trial + 30d extension. Potential: mid-six-figure ARR (POC -> production) if we win; public marketplace placement and a published case study likely.

My proposed controlled offer: 30k credits now; 30d trial; extension available based on results sharing. Include a 15% onboarding credit post-selection. We should require a simple MSA and a short non-disclosure for test data; no custom dev commitments.

Attachments: deal_summary.pdf (quick ARR/ACV assumptions).

Asking: sign-off to provision 30k credits and permission to offer the 15% onboarding credit conditionally. If you want, I can drop to 20k + extension option to reduce exposure. Please advise — need to confirm to procurement this afternoon.

Thanks,
Vanessa

---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: MarketFit bake-off — credit ask (Swan Health)

Vanessa — thanks for the summary and the quick turnaround. My thoughts:

- Approve a promotional allocation, but cap it at 20k credits immediately. That keeps unit exposure contained.
- Offer the 30-day trial and an option for a single 30-day extension contingent on the delivery of interim results and a signed LOA.
- Approve conditional 15% onboarding credit only if they sign an MSA within 60 days of selection.

If procurement pushes back for 50k, escalate to me and I’ll take to Revenue leadership. For now, provision 20k and include the extension language. Also loop Finance for the tracking tag.

-Stephanie
Head of Revenue Operations

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@swanhealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Solutions <solutions@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: credits for an upcoming benchmark sprint

Hi Emma — thanks for the patience.

Final offer from Redwood: 20,000 token-equivalent credits provisioned immediately, 30-day trial window, with one possible 30-day extension if Swan Health provides interim results and signs a short Letter of Agreement (LOA). We’ll also apply a 15% onboarding credit to the first committed month if you choose Redwood within 60 days after selection and sign our MSA.

Next steps we suggest:
- I’ll provision the 20k credits today and share access details.
- Quick calibration call (30 min) to align on input sample set and scoring scripts — can your team do Wednesday at 10am PT?
- Procurement: we’ll send a simple LOA and a DocuSign link for the MSA when applicable.

Attachments: nada (credits will be provisioned by the platform). DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/fixture/abc123-sign

If this works, I’ll ask Finance to tag the credits to deal SWH-2027-0412 and provision immediately.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

---

From: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@swanhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@swanhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: credits for an upcoming benchmark sprint

Vanessa — that works for us. Please proceed with provisioning 20k credits and send the calibration call invite for Wednesday 10am PT. Procurement has reviewed the LOA language and is OK with the extension clause. We will also share interim scorecards so you can validate outputs during the extension period.

Once you provision, we’ll kick off the benchmark and keep you posted on timing — Swan Health will include benchmark results in our RFP evaluation pack.

Thanks again — looking forward to the call.
Emma Clarke
Senior Product Manager, Data Platform
Swan Health
